clamav-no-infected-files.name: ClamAV: no infected files found
clamav-no-infected-files.description: The most recent ClamAV scan reported its results, and the number of infected files is 0.

clamav-scan-within-last-week.name: ClamAV: scan ran within the last week
clamav-scan-within-last-week.description: A ClamAV scan completed on the host within the last 7 days.

rules.sql:
SELECT
  h.hostkey,
  h.hostname,
  h.ipaddress,
  i.values ->> 'OS' AS os,
  i.values ->> 'ClamAV last scan completed' AS scan_completed
FROM
  hosts h
  JOIN inventory_new i ON h.hostkey = i.hostkey
WHERE
  TO_TIMESTAMP(
    i.values ->> 'ClamAV last scan completed',
    'YYYY:MM:DD HH24:MI:SS'
  ) > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '1 week'

clamav-signatures-fresh.name: ClamAV: signatures updated within 2 weeks
clamav-signatures-fresh.description: The ClamAV virus signature database was updated within the last 14 days.

rules.sql:
SELECT
  h.hostkey,
  h.hostname,
  h.ipaddress,
  i.values ->> 'OS' AS os,
  i.values ->> 'ClamAV Signatures last updated' AS signatures_updated
FROM
  hosts h
  JOIN inventory_new i ON h.hostkey = i.hostkey
WHERE
  TO_TIMESTAMP(
    i.values ->> 'ClamAV Signatures last updated',
    'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'
  ) > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '2 weeks'
